DECISION: Replace remote derived-text handling for this flow with on-device processing. DECISION: Exclude file content from telemetry for this flow.","S":"IN: Local parsing, local text derivation, local AI/analysis path, telemetry redaction for file-related errors. OUT: Remote AI use, remote telemetry carrying file bytes, metadata, or derived text.","V":"Verify primary-format files complete without outbound content transfer. Verify telemetry contains no file bytes, metadata, or derived text. Verify failure paths keep the same boundary.","X":"Stop before non-primary formats that lack on-device support. Stop before any change needing server retention or remote inference.","P":"DECISION: Default to local-only handling for this feature until a new boundary is explicitly approved.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"risk-02-refund-authority","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"What refund authority should support own directly, and when must someone else approve it?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"Should support handle partial refunds as well as full refunds within that authority?","scripted_answer_index":1,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"DECISION: Let support issue customer refunds with bounded authority.","T":"FACT: Payment provider supports full and partial refunds. FACT: Support billing access is read-only today. DECISION: Support may refund up to $100 with a required reason. DECISION: Larger refunds require an owner approval. DECISION: Allow full and partial refunds within that limit. DECISION: Record an audit event for every refund and approval.","S":"IN: Support refund action, partial/full refund entry, reason capture, owner approval gate above $100, audit logging, role update from read-only. OUT: Unbounded refunds, refunds without reason, refunds above $100 without owner approval.","V":"Verify support can refund up to $100 only with a reason. Verify amounts above $100 are blocked until owner approval. Verify full and partial refunds both honor the limit. Verify audit events capture actor, amount, reason, approver when required.","X":"Stop before charge disputes, credits outside provider refunds, or policy decisions beyond the $100 threshold.","P":"DECISION: Use the provider's existing refund APIs and current billing surface with reversible role and gate changes.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"risk-03-data-retention","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"What outcome should automatic upload cleanup guarantee for old customer uploads and any report data that depends on them?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"What should users be told about recovery after deletion, given backups can retain objects for 30 days?","scripted_answer_index":1,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"DECISION: Automatically clean up old customer uploads under an explicit retention outcome.","T":"FACT: Uploads may be referenced by completed reports. FACT: Backups retain objects for 30 days. DECISION: Delete uploads 90 days after their last report finishes. DECISION: Keep report summaries. DECISION: Tell users deletion is final even though disaster-recovery backups age out later.","S":"IN: Age calculation from last completed report, upload deletion, preservation of report summaries, user-facing retention/deletion wording, backup-aware messaging. OUT: Deleting report summaries, deleting uploads before the last report finishes, promising user recovery from backups.","V":"Verify uploads tied to active or unfinished reports are not deleted. Verify uploads are deleted 90 days after the last report finishes. Verify report summaries remain available. Verify user-facing messaging states deletion is final while backups age out separately.","X":"Stop before defining backup retention beyond the existing 30-day disaster-recovery window. Stop before deleting report summaries or redesigning report storage.","P":"DECISION: Apply the 90-day rule as the reversible default retention policy for uploads until replaced by an accepted policy.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true}]}
